files.prompt_en: Create one full-length character illustration for a story-driven exploration game, painted with restrained brush texture, carefully shaded fabric and a muted earthy palette. A single person stands in a relaxed three-quarter pose facing slightly toward the viewer, with head, hands and boots entirely visible. Center the figure within a vertical 1024 by 1536 canvas with clear space around the silhouette. Soft diffuse light makes the face readable. Both hands are empty. The background is completely transparent with clean alpha edges, and the entire image contains only the character. Depict Zag, a lean adult swordsman with short tousled dark brown hair, a clean-shaven angular face and an attentive, slightly questioning expression. He wears a worn ochre-brown short jacket over a charcoal blue tunic, a plain belt, dark fitted trousers and practical leather boots. One hand rests loosely near his waist while the other is gently open. His clothing carries subtle wear from travel.
files.prompt_ja: 物語中心の探索ゲーム用の全身人物画を一枚制作する。控えめな筆の質感、丁寧に陰影を付けた布地、落ち着いた土の色を使う。一人の人物が見る側へ少し向いた自然な斜め正面の姿勢で立ち、頭・両手・靴をすべて画面に収める。縦1024×1536の中央に配置し、輪郭の周囲へ余白を取る。柔らかな拡散光で顔を見やすくする。両手は空。背景を完全に透明とし、輪郭のアルファをきれいに保ち、画像には人物だけを描く。ザグは細身の成人剣士で、短く乱れた暗褐色の髪、ひげのない角張った顔、注意深く少し問いかけるような表情。黄土茶色の使い込んだ短い上着、墨青色のチュニック、簡素なベルト、暗色の細身のズボン、実用的な革靴を着用。一方の手を腰の近くに自然に置き、もう一方を軽く開く。衣服には旅による控えめな使用感がある。
